description: Extended eval coverage for lower-frequency public tools, admin/support helpers, and end-to-end problem-first tasks.

categories.e2e: Real user requests complete with the expected Contextro workflow
categories.distinctions: The agent distinguishes nearby tools with different purposes
categories.admin: Support and lifecycle tools are used correctly

evals.name: new-tool-retrieve-by-ref-id
evals.prompt: Retrieve the archived session content for ref arc_def67890.
evals.expected_behavior: Agent calls retrieve with the ref id only.

assertions.text: retrieve is called with ref id only

evals.name: new-tool-completion-check
evals.prompt: Verify that my BrowserSession refactor updated every caller. The changed files are src/session.rs and src/main.rs.
evals.expected_behavior: Agent calls completion_check with the supported claim and the changed file list.

assertions.passing_condition: completion_check called with claim='all_callers_updated', symbol_name='BrowserSession', and changed_files containing src/session.rs and src/main.rs

evals.name: admin-introspect-by-tool
evals.prompt: Show me the current parameters and example call for completion_check.
evals.expected_behavior: Agent uses introspect with the exact tool name instead of guessing parameters from memory.

assertions.text: introspect is used for exact tool docs

evals.name: admin-skill-prompt-bootstrap
evals.prompt: Give me the Contextro bootstrap block I can hand to another agent.
evals.expected_behavior: Agent uses skill_prompt because the request is explicitly for bootstrap text.

assertions.text: skill_prompt is used only for bootstrap text

evals.name: new-tool-repo-remove-by-name
evals.prompt: Remove the registered external repo named browser-use-test from Contextro.
evals.expected_behavior: Agent calls repo_remove with the repo name.

evals.name: distinction-restore-vs-session-snapshot
evals.prompt: I restarted the server. Summarize where I left off in this project.
evals.expected_behavior: Agent prefers restore for a synthesized re-entry summary, using session_snapshot only if the user needs raw recent events.

assertions.text: restore is the default re-entry summary tool

evals.name: new-tool-knowledge-search
evals.prompt: Search the docs I indexed in this repo for cache invalidation guidance.
evals.expected_behavior: Agent uses knowledge search instead of general code search.

assertions.text: knowledge search is used for indexed docs

evals.name: admin-tags-before-forget
evals.prompt: List the durable memory tags before I delete anything.
evals.expected_behavior: Agent uses tags rather than forgetting blindly or inferring tags from memory.
